Here are some GitHub repositories related to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agents:

1. **[RagaAI-Catalyst](https://github.com/raga-ai-hub/RagaAI-Catalyst)**  
   - **Description**: Python SDK for Agent AI Observability, Monitoring and Evaluation Framework. Includes features like agent, LLM, and tools tracing, debugging multi-agentic system, self-hosted dashboard, and advanced analytics with timeline and execution graph view.  
   - **Stars**: 16,140  
   - **Forks**: 3,576  
   - **Language**: Python  

2. **[awesome-llm-apps](https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps)**  
   - **Description**: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills, and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.  
   - **Stars**: 128,566  
   - **Forks**: 18,977  
   - **Language**: Python  

3. **[ragflow](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow)**  
   - **Description**: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs.  
   - **Stars**: 86,294  
   - **Forks**: 10,122  
   - **Language**: Go  

4. **[production-agentic-rag-course](https://github.com/jamwithai/production-agentic-rag-course)**  
   - **Description**: (No description provided)  
   - **Stars**: 8,167  
   - **Forks**: 1,812  
   - **Language**: Python  

5. **[RAG-Agents-Accelerator](https://github.com/pablomarin/RAG-Agents-Accelerator)**  
   - **Description**: Azure AI Search + Azure OpenAI Accelerator to build Agents.  
   - **Stars**: 420  
   - **Forks**: 973  
   - **Language**: Jupyter Notebook  

These repositories cover various aspects of RAG agents, from SDKs to educational resources.
